##  Installation

#### NPM &mdash; [npmjs.com](https://www.npmjs.com/)
``` markup
$ npm install adapta
```
#### Composer &mdash; [getcomposer.org](https://getcomposer.org/)
``` markup
$ composer install wdsgna/adapta
```
